item.name: Bind a use case to a platform service

request.name: Bind a use case to a platform service

description.content: Bind this use case to a platform service in the current workspace. PUT semantics — rebinding to a different service replaces the prior binding. Inbound webhook events for the use case will resolve to this workspace; outbound dispatch from the service will route through this use case for its channel. 409 if a different use case already binds the same (service, channel) pair. 404 if the service or use case is missing or belongs to another workspace. Requires Channel.create permission.
